title: Chapter 1434 - 11: Lin Yuan'S Future Self

Chapter 1434 - 11: Lin Yuan'S Future Self

Chapter 1434 - 11: Lin Yuan's Future Self

The future selves that the Time Lords can perceive and summon are not the future selves that Lin Yuan cultivated through the "Three Lives Technique".

The latter is based on the current and past selves, condensed from marks on multiple future timelines, while the former... is the true and undistorted future.

Whether or not one has cultivated the "Three Lives Technique" and become a Time Lord.

The future indeed exists; it's just undetectable and uncallable below the Time Lord level.

A time life being can observe future timelines, but that doesn't mean they can communicate with their future self.

"The Blood Sea Lord is actually summoning his future self?"

"Could it be that the future self the Blood Sea Lord senses has already taken that step?"

The Time Lords watching around had serious expressions. Normally, summoning a future self is not very significant for a Lord.

But the Blood Sea Lord did it anyway. With the Blood Sea Lord's methods, they wouldn't do something meaningless, so there are only a few possible reasons.

[Your understanding is extraordinary, observing timeline changes, enhancing your perception of the future...]

Compared to the tense Time Lords, Lin Yuan was caught in a form of enlightenment at the moment.

The Blood Sea Lord forcefully disrupted the normal timeline, and the resulting temporal fluctuations were an enormous inspiration to Lin Yuan, who was one step away from becoming a Lord.

It's difficult to sense and connect with one's future without reaching the Time Lord level, which holds true for normal Time Lords.

Lin Yuan naturally doesn't fall into that category; with his insight and control over the rules of the great path, he far surpassed ordinary Time Lords. The only barrier for Lin Yuan becoming a Time Lord was the consolidation and sealing of his personal timeline.

...

"Blood Sea Lord, are you so confident in your future?"

The voice of the colossal Tianshi Lord reverberated through space-time. He had already revealed his true form, the extreme of the second level, not much smaller than the top-tier dimension of the Chaos Void.

"Trying to run now? It's too late."

The Blood Sea Lord's gaze was indifferent. Once the technique of summoning a future self began, it couldn't be stopped, and the Blood Sea Lord had no intention of stopping. How could they let the Tianshi Lord ruin their plans just like that?

Whir——

The vast Blood Sea behind the Blood Sea Lord was swaying, an endless Blood Sea continuously condensed, forming a figure far more magnificent than the Blood Sea Lord.

This magnificent figure had bright red hair and resembled the Blood Sea Lord greatly, but its aura was much more terrifying, even as it spanned hundreds of cataclysmic time cycles, suffocating the numerous Time Lords present.

"A Legendary Lord, has the Blood Sea Lord already found a future where he becomes a Legendary Lord?"

The hearts of the Time Lords watching sank. If it was previously just speculation, now it was certain.

The future of the Blood Sea Lord, where he himself could sense a segment of time, had smoothly stepped into the Legendary tier, becoming a third-stage Lord of the 'Infinite Tribulation'.

"The Tianshi Lord is in trouble this time."

The Time Lords looked towards the Tianshi Lord. Facing a Legendary-tier Lord, even if it's only the future self of a Legendary-tier Lord, even a second-tier ultimate Lord might not be able to withstand it.

The 'Infinite Tribulation' has three stages; the third stage is a qualitative change compared to the previous two stages.

"Big brother's future..."

The Void Spirit Lord and Lord of Armor simultaneously observed the towering red figure behind the Blood Sea Lord, their thoughts complex.

The Blood Sea Lord had already found his path to legend. What about them? The future sensed by the two Time Lords was either dying in a certain tribulation of the Infinite Tribulation or still struggling at their current level.

"Legend..."

The Tianshi Lord looked at the Blood Sea Lord and the towering red figure behind him, "Even if your future self really steps into legend, with different time periods between us, I refuse to believe you can act as you wish."

In terms of strength, the Tianshi Lord surely wasn't the match of a Legendary Lord.

The only thing the Tianshi Lord could rely on was that this time-space was his home ground, and the Blood Sea Lord's legendary future self would be suppressed and suffer backlash when acting here.

For example, if a current time-space Lord were to act in the past, they would also be suppressed and backlash would ensue from the timeline.

The future Legendary Lord acting in the present time-space follows a similar principle.

"Roar!!!"

The pair of grey horns atop the Tianshi Lord's head burst forth with an extremely profound aura, the resulting twisted power like an ocean surging towards the Blood Sea Lord.

Faced with the Blood Sea Lord, already Legendary-tier across many times and spaces, the Tianshi Lord didn't retreat an inch, directly taking the initiative to strike.

...

"Is that the Tianshi Lord's most powerful move 'Oblivion Horn'?" The surrounding Time Lords were aghast.

As a famed Lord, the Tianshi Lord's many killing moves were widely known among the Time Lords, among which the 'Oblivion Horn' was the Tianshi Lord's most formidable move.

Since becoming a Time Lord, the Tianshi Lord had used this move only five times, and each time the enemy was swept away.

Of these enemies, two had already touched the threshold of legend at the second tier, yet facing the 'Oblivion Horn', they had no ability to resist.

"Oblivion Horn?"

The Blood Sea Lord's expression was heavy.

If faced with this move, the best response would be to retreat and avoid the edge.

The power of the 'Oblivion Horn' was incredibly terrifying, but the cost was also great. After the Tianshi Lord used the Oblivion Horn, it took at least tens of billions of years to recover and recuperate each time.
